title: Everyday Critical Thinking
tagline: Spot weak claims, tame your biases, and reason clearly about a noisy world.
curricula: Informal-logic courses, UW's Calling Bullshit curriculum, and Tetlock's Good Judgment forecasting research
endpoint: from gut takes to calmly dismantling a weak claim
about: Critical thinking is the discipline of believing things for good reasons — spotting weak claims, checking sources, and noticing when your own mind is the one fooling you. This category covers the practical toolkit: how arguments work, the biases everyone carries, how statistics mislead, and the habits that keep reasoning honest in a noisy information environment.
